correctness.rationale: Conditional on the cyclic set, all directed forests with those k roots are equiprobable because their k! cyclic permutations are equinumerous. Collapse each root arrow to one symbol; each admissible parent vector with r root arrows contributes k^r. Enumerating all (m+1)^m parent vectors with explicit cycle rejection yields exact polynomials W_m=k(k+m)^(m−1), A_m=ka_m and B_m=kb_m for m=2..5. Cov=(b_m(k)(k+m)^(m−1)−a_m(k)²)/(k+m)^(2m−2), giving P2=−1; P3=k²−2k−19; P4=3k⁴+46k³+192k²+24k−836; P5=5k⁶+168k⁵+2217k⁴+14072k³+40503k²+25728k−64261. Sign P3 changes between 5 and 6; P4 between 1 and 2; P5 positive for all k>=1; P2 negative throughout. m≥2 and k≥1 are enforced, and n<=5 has no positive instance. Independent exact parent-vector implementation checked 16 polynomial assertions and reproduced m=5 W/A/B coefficient rows; polynomial symbolic enumeration proves every integer k in scope, unlike finite k sampling.
